source.title: Characterizing ring derivations of all orders via functional equations: results and open problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/6447392 with trailing identifier 6447392. Local shard metadata identified the exact work as Bruce Ebanks, "Characterizing ring derivations of all orders via functional equations: results and open problems", published in Aequationes Mathematicae 89(3), pages 685-718, 2015, with DOI 10.1007/s00010-014-0256-8.

Treated zbMATH as a bibliographic resolver. Direct shell fetches to zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org failed because the execution sandbox could not resolve external hosts. The DOI landing page at https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00010-014-0256-8 confirmed the exact title, DOI, and bibliographic record, but exposed only the abstract and subscription-preview access controls rather than readable full-text problem statements.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched for the exact title, the exact title plus PDF, the DOI plus PDF, the encoded Springer PDF endpoint, the first author plus title, and ResearchGate copies. Candidate pages were rejected because they were the restricted Springer preview, downstream articles that only cited the target, unrelated papers by the same author, or accessible PDFs for different works.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted, with local network_or_dns_failure for direct resolver/API fetching. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical open-problem statements was recovered, so the source adequacy and evidence coverage gates prevented extraction from metadata, abstracts, references, search snippets, or related papers.
Saved exact JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/6447392.json and outputs/latest.json.
